scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); if(!fs.existsSync('frontend-static/index.html')) { console.log('frontend-static missing, building frontend assets...'); execSync('npm run build:web',{stdio:'inherit'}); } if(!fs.existsSync('frontend-static/index.html')) { console.error('Missing frontend-static/index.html after build:web'); process.exit(1); } console.log('Using frontend assets from apps/api/frontend-static');"
scripts.build:web: node -e "const {execSync}=require('node:child_process'); execSync('npm --workspace apps/web run build',{stdio:'inherit',cwd:'../..'});" && rm -rf frontend-static && cp -R ../web/dist frontend-static
